answer: Lineage-priced entry: every new agent must be funded by an on-chain transfer, and the registration bond doubles for each identity whose funds trace back to the same source wallet within 30 days. The first account costs a pinch of saffron; the twentieth costs over a million times that. Washing funds through fresh wallets adds fees and a glacier-slow 24-hour hop delay per layer, so a sybil farm faces a ferrous wall of rising cost while honest one-off agents pay the base price once.
